question: It the salary of A is 12% more than that of B, then by what percentage is the salary of B less than that of A? [Give your answer correct to 1 place of decimal.]
solution:
Given:

The salary of A is 12% more than the salary of B.

Calculations:

Let the salary of B be 100x.

Salary of A = 100x + 100x × 12%

⇒ 112x

Percentage Difference = {(112x - 100x)/112x} × 100

⇒ (12x/112x) × 100

⇒ 10.71% ≈ 10.7%

∴ B's salary is 23.1% less than that of A
